title_en: Iterate on images through multi-turn conversation
content_en: Iterate and refine instead of expecting a perfect image on the first try. Use the conversational nature of the model to make small changes with follow-up prompts. Multi-turn conversation is the recommended way to iterate on images.

applies_when_en: A generated image is close to the intent, but one or two things are off (lighting, expression, color, a detail), and the next step would be rewriting the whole prompt or regenerating from scratch.
not_applies_when_en: A new image unrelated to the previous one is needed; the result misses the intent entirely (a new prompt is needed); the model is Lite with a long chain of edits; the character features have already drifted after many edits (then start a new conversation).
needs_from_prompt_en: a previously generated image in the same conversation
forbids_in_output_en: Don't expect a perfect image on the first try

If a character's features begin to drift after many iterative edits, a new conversation can be started with a detailed description to retain consistency. (models: nb25)
Follow-up prompts in the same conversation, such as a request to "try again", also count toward the usage limit. (models: unspecified)

title_en: Refine with follow-up commands, not rewrites
content_en: A chat session can refine an image iteratively: start with a base image and issue follow-up commands that change specific details, such as colors or objects, without rewriting the entire prompt from scratch.
applies_when_en: The prompt is the second or a later turn in the same chat, and only a targeted edit of one detail (color, object, lighting, pose, background) is needed instead of re-describing the whole scene.
not_applies_when_en: The first turn (the scene still has to be described in full); a new chat without history, where a back-reference to the previous subject points to nothing; an API call without previous_interaction_id and without passed history; a series built on explicit references where the previous model turn is not visible (there the images are labeled Image 1 / Image 2).
needs_from_prompt_en: a base image in the same chat session
forbids_in_output_en: removing a person from a group photo
caveats_en: The model works with the user all along to alter specific parts of an image while preserving the rest. (models: nb25)
Edit specific parts of images conversationally, without changing anything else. (models: other)
Changes from removing a person from a group photo to fixing a small detail like a stain can be made through a simple conversation. (models: nb25)
Direct, conversational commands can modify specific elements within the image without complex software or re-generating the entire scene. (models: unspecified)

title_en: Unspecified details carry over from previous scene
content_en: In the next scene of a series, details that the prompt does not specify are carried over from the previous scene reference. When no lighting details are given, the light source, quality, and direction are preserved from the previous scene. When one element changes and no additional details are given for the view or the surroundings, the model generally preserves most of the existing elements.
applies_when_en: The next scene of a series with a scene reference, and it is unclear whether lighting, background and surroundings have to be described again.
not_applies_when_en: The first scene; a new element without a description (it varies); something has to be removed, which must be stated explicitly.
needs_from_prompt_en: the previous scene as a reference image
caveats_en: "Generally" and "most": preservation is not guaranteed. (models: lite)

Where no precise description of a new setting is given, repeated requests produce different, interesting, and creative results; pick a favorite or make the prompt more precise for greater determinism. (models: lite)

title_en: Illustrate a book through a separate image chat
content_en:
Pipeline for many illustrations of one text with recurring characters and a single style:
1. Use a separate chat instance (chain) for the image model, apart from the text-model chat that reads the book and writes the prompts.
2. Setup turn: "You are going to generate portrait images to illustrate The Wind in the Willows from Kenneth Grahame. The style we want you to follow is: {style} Also follow those rules: {system_instructions}"
3. Transition turn: "Starting from now, we're going to illustrate the book's chapters. Don't forget to refer to your previous illustrations of the characters to keep the characters consistency, but feel free to change their position."
4. Per-item turn: "Create an illustration for {chapter['name']} using the previously generated characters following this description: {chapter['prompt']}"
applies_when_en: Long work: many illustrations for one text (a book, a script) with recurring characters and a single style.
not_applies_when_en: One or two images; the characters do not recur.
needs_from_prompt_en: a scene description for each item
caveats_en: Slot labels are template notation, not prompt text.

Alternative without chaining: pass only the selected character reference images per call: "Create this illustration for {chapter['name']}: {chapter['prompt']} Use the provided images as references of what the characters look like." (models: unspecified)
